cells.gaps: No source found says a law on AI itself, applying across sectors, is in force. The 2025 mandate to present a draft AI regulation names no text that has been published.
cells.note: Article 57 of the data protection law names AI and obliges AI developers and providers to declare to the authority, a rule in force for one use, as Nigeria's data protection directive is read. It is not a law on AI itself, so not stage 4.
